# Introduce your brand

**Kansas City Area’s ****Top Rated**** Coating Provider**

**(816) 607-7017**

# Our Expertise
* #### Powder Coatings
  
  With our top of the line powder equipment, your products will be expertly finished every time,
  exactly to spec. Our team has the experience, training, and reliability to have the same amazing
  results, time and time again.
* #### Custom Paint Coatings
  
  From Urethanes, to Epoxies, to Enamels and anything in between, we provide first class coatings,
  servicing a wide array of industries, including commercial, industrial, and agricultural
  applications.
* #### Marine & Aerospace Coatings
  
  Marine & Aerospace coatings are among the most technically advanced of all coatings we excell in,
  as they operate in very dynamic and hostile environments.
* #### Single & Multi Stage Finishings
  
  From the simplest of products to complex components, we have the experience and capability to
  provide a top quality finished product.
* #### Blasting
  
  Surface prep is key to a solid and long lasting coating. Our blast services are expertly preformed
  to ensure a top quality outcome every time.
* #### Additional Services
  
  All inclusive capabilities from surface prep, to custom masking, to rust proofing , to custom
  packaging, we have you covered from start to finish.

[ All Services ][8]

## **Advanced Coatings**

## One Mission, One Accepted Result - Your Total Satisfaction

At Advanced Coatings, our mission is to provide the highest quality custom, architectural,
ornamental and industrial finishing services. Our services and projects range from walk-ins to large
contractors, both local and out of state. With 90+ years of experience in multiple areas of the
trade, our knowledgeable staff brings our customers' projects to final finishes.

## Get in Touch

#### Advanced Coatings

(816) 607-7017

info@advancedcoatings.com

adhesives, coatings, potting compounds, and technical ceramics.
[Our Products][83] [Get In Touch][84]

For dicing ceramics, semiconductors, and single crystalline materials.

[Read More][88]

# A Leader in High Temperature Solutions

Since 1965, Aremco has been a leader in the development and production of high-temperature
adhesives, coatings, potting compounds, and technical ceramics.
[Our Products][83] [Get In Touch][84]

## Featured Product Categories

[[High Temperature Mounting Adhesives]][85]

### High Temperature Mounting Adhesives

For dicing ceramics, semiconductors, and single crystalline materials.

[Read More][86]

[[HiE-Coat™ 840-M]][87]

### High Temperature High Emissivity Coatings

Black-body coatings for applications to 2,500°F

[Read More][88]

[[Ceramabond™ 670]][89]

### High Temperature Ceramic Adhesives

For bonding, potting and sealing to 3,200°F.

[Read More][90]

[[Aremcolox 502-600]][91]

### Machinable Ceramics

Alumina Aluminum Nitride, Alumino-Silicate, Boron Nitride, Glass Ceramics, Magnesia, Zirconia.

[Read More][92]

## Customer Driven, Application Focused, and Committed to Quality

At Aremco, we prioritize our customers by building strong relationships, understanding their needs,
and offering personalized solutions with expert support.

With decades of experience in high-temperature materials, we offer innovative products like
adhesives, coatings, sealants, and ceramics designed for extreme condition

purchases.

THE SURFACE ENGINEERS

# Provider of innovative PVD, CVD & PACVD coating services

[ Get in touch ][184]

Enhanced performance in demanding machining

## Ionbond CVD 29 Ultra: Extended tool life through high durability

[ Read more ][185]

## We provide thin-film coating services worldwide

Ionbond provides thin-film coating services and operates worldwide. Its coatings are used to improve
durability, quality, functionality, efficiency and aesthetics of tools and components. Our portfolio
includes [PVD][186], [PACVD][187], [CVD][188], [CVA][189] and CVI technologies, including a broad
range of [DLC coatings][190].

### Over 50 years of experience in coating technology

Our global and regional experts are here to support you with state-of-the-art knowledge so that we
can deliver world-class products to you wherever you are.

### Innovative standard and customized PVD, CVD, and PACVD coating solutions

We are always eager to take on your challenging, highly specialized coating applications to serve
you with the solution you looking for.

### Extensive world wide network in Europe, North America and Asia

Benefit from our extensive network with around 30 coating centers in 14 countries.

## Coating service portfolio for specific markets

### Cutting tools

State-of-the-art coatings for high-speed steels (HSS) and cemented carbide cutting tools

[ Read more ][191]

### Forming and Molding Tools

Improve productivity, maintain excellent product quality and minimize scrap rate

[ Read more ][192]

### Components

Boosting the performance of components for industrial machinery

[ Read more ][193]

### Mobility

Thin-film coating solutions engineered for durability, efficiency, and controlled performance across
modern mobility applications.

[ Read more ][194]

### Aerospace

Enhance performance, decrease operation costs and push application limits

[ Read more ][195]

### Decorative

High quality decorative coatings to ensure perfect appearance in extreme environments

[ Read more ][196]

### Coating for medical

Biocompatible certified medical coatings

[ Read more ][197]

### Food contact

Safe and hard high-performance coatings for food processing

[ Read more ][198]

### Decarbonization

Surface engineering solutions for batteries, PEM electrolyzers, and PEM fuel cells.

[ Read more ][199]

Europe, North America & Asia

## Extensive worldwide network

Benefit from our extensive worldwide network and our wide experience in [coating technology][200]
which is available from each of our service centers.

[ Our locations ][201]

## Read and find articles crafted exact for you

[ All articles ][202]
[ Coatings ][203]

### From Automotive to Mobility: How Ionbond expands its focus for the future of transportation

The global transportation landscape is undergoing profound change. Electrification, hydrogen
technologies, autonomous systems and new mobility concepts are reshaping what was once a
predominantly automotive-driven industry. Reflecting this evolution, Ionbond has renamed its
Automotive segment to Mobility, marking an important step in how the company positions itself for
the future.

[ Read more ][204]
[ Collaboration ][205]

### Ionbond & Sodebo: A technical partnership behind a historic world record

Sodebo’s new Jules Verne Trophy record marks a defining moment in offshore sailing, showcasing
exceptional skill, teamwork and technical precision. Since 2020, Ionbond has been supporting the
team’s pursuit of performance and reliability at sea. Discover the full story on our collaboration
and how we help empower the Sodebo team.

[ Read more ][206]
[ Coatings ][207]

### Decobond™ Black Raven: Advanced decorative PVD coating for demanding applications

When it comes to products that require long-lasting design, durability and appearance are equally
important. Ionbond’s Decobond™ Black Raven [decorative PVD coating][208] is engineered specifically
for these demands, offering a unique combination of strong [wear resistance][209] and a long lasting
dark black metallic finish.

[ Read more ][210]
[ Coatings ][211]

### Introducing Olive Drab Green

## A bold new PVD coating for extreme conditions

Responding to market demand for durability and style under the toughest conditions, Ionbond proudly
unveils its latest [decorative color][212]: Olive Drab Green (ODG) PVD coating for metal substrates.

[ Read more ][213]
[ Events ][214]

### Ionbond's 2025 highlights

As the year closes, we take a clear look at what we achieved together. We value every step our
teams, customers and partners made possible. Each month in 2025 reflects a specific gift that shaped
our progress. Please unwrap the video and explore the gifts that defined 2025.

[ Read more ][215]
[ Service Centers ][216]

### Expanding coating capacity at Ionbond Berthecourt

We are pleased to announce a major investment at our Berthecourt facility: the installation of a new
Hauzer Flexicoat 1000 machine featuring advanced CARC+ technology. This strategic upgrade
significantly expands our coating capacity and productivity, enabling us to meet growing customer
demands with greater efficiency.

[ Read more ][217]
[ Collaboration ][218]

### Ionbond proudly receives Bosch Global Supplier Award

Ionbond has received a Bosch Global Supplier Award in the category "Materials and components" and
thus ranks globally among the best suppliers of Bosch. The theme of this year’s award ceremony was
“Challenge accepted: resilient partnerships, sustainable future,” in recognition of successful
collaboration.

[ Read more ][219]
[ Coatings ][220]

### Ionbond™ CVD 29 Ultra: Enhanced performance in continuous and interrupted cutting

Ionbond is pleased to announce our latest addition to our chemical vapor deposition ([CVD][221])
coating portfolio: Ionbond™ CVD 29 Ultra. This coating provides an impressive performance boost in
demanding applications, such as high-performance continuous and interrupted machining.

[ Read more ][222]
[ Collaboration ][223]

### 55 years of CVD coating: great memories and a promising future

Ionbond & Bernex celebrates 55 years of [CVD coating][224] excellence from Swiss origins to global
innovation. Discover our journey, future vision, and industry impact. Read the full interview to
explore how we’re shaping the next chapter in [surface technology][225].

[ Read more ][226]
[ Coatings ][227]

### Ionbond Ducro Coatings - cold dark black chrome PVD coating with superior characteristics

A striking cold anthracite color + excellent performance in extreme conditions. That’s the Ionbond
Ducro coating. Read more about the Ducro benefits and let yourself be wowed by its looks.

[ Read more ][228]
[ Service Centers ][229]

### Ionbond expands DLC coating capacity in Toulouse

Ionbond is proud to announce a strategic investment in its Grisolles facility near Toulouse, France,
with the installation of an HC1200 coating system from IHI Hauzer to significantly expand our DLC
(Diamond-Like Carbon) coating capacity.

[ Read more ][230]
[ Coatings ][231]

We are excited to launch the second edition of the Ionbond Summer School program. This time on the

THE SURFACE ENGINEERS

# Provider of innovative PVD, CVD & PACVD coating services

[ Get in touch ][184]

Enhanced performance in demanding machining

## Ionbond CVD 29 Ultra: Extended tool life through high durability

[ Read more ][185]

## We provide thin-film coating services worldwide

Ionbond provides thin-film coating services and operates worldwide. Its coatings are used to improve
durability, quality, functionality, efficiency and aesthetics of tools and components. Our portfolio
includes [PVD][186], [PACVD][187], [CVD][188], [CVA][189] and CVI technologies, including a broad
range of [DLC coatings][190].

### Over 50 years of experience in coating technology

Our global and regional experts are here to support you with state-of-the-art knowledge so that we
can deliver world-class products to you wherever you are.

### Innovative standard and customized PVD, CVD, and PACVD coating solutions

We are always eager to take on your challenging, highly specialized coating applications to serve
you with the solution you looking for.

### Extensive world wide network in Europe, North America and Asia

Benefit from our extensive network with around 30 coating centers in 14 countries.

## Coating service portfolio for specific markets

### Cutting tools

State-of-the-art coatings for high-speed steels (HSS) and cemented carbide cutting tools

[ Read more ][191]

### Forming and Molding Tools

Improve productivity, maintain excellent product quality and minimize scrap rate

[ Read more ][192]

### Components

Boosting the performance of components for industrial machinery

[ Read more ][193]

### Mobility

Thin-film coating solutions engineered for durability, efficiency, and controlled performance across
modern mobility applications.

[ Read more ][194]

### Aerospace

Enhance performance, decrease operation costs and push application limits

[ Read more ][195]

### Decorative

High quality decorative coatings to ensure perfect appearance in extreme environments

[ Read more ][196]

### Coating for medical

Biocompatible certified medical coatings

[ Read more ][197]

### Food contact

Safe and hard high-performance coatings for food processing

[ Read more ][198]

### Decarbonization

Surface engineering solutions for batteries, PEM electrolyzers, and PEM fuel cells.

[ Read more ][199]

Europe, North America & Asia

## Extensive worldwide network

Benefit from our extensive worldwide network and our wide experience in [coating technology][200]
which is available from each of our service centers.

[ Our locations ][201]

## Read and find articles crafted exact for you

[ All articles ][202]
[ Coatings ][203]

### From Automotive to Mobility: How Ionbond expands its focus for the future of transportation

The global transportation landscape is undergoing profound change. Electrification, hydrogen
technologies, autonomous systems and new mobility concepts are reshaping what was once a
predominantly automotive-driven industry. Reflecting this evolution, Ionbond has renamed its
Automotive segment to Mobility, marking an important step in how the company positions itself for
the future.

[ Read more ][204]
[ Collaboration ][205]

### Ionbond & Sodebo: A technical partnership behind a historic world record

Sodebo’s new Jules Verne Trophy record marks a defining moment in offshore sailing, showcasing
exceptional skill, teamwork and technical precision. Since 2020, Ionbond has been supporting the
team’s pursuit of performance and reliability at sea. Discover the full story on our collaboration
and how we help empower the Sodebo team.

[ Read more ][206]
[ Coatings ][207]

### Decobond™ Black Raven: Advanced decorative PVD coating for demanding applications

When it comes to products that require long-lasting design, durability and appearance are equally
important. Ionbond’s Decobond™ Black Raven [decorative PVD coating][208] is engineered specifically
for these demands, offering a unique combination of strong [wear resistance][209] and a long lasting
dark black metallic finish.

[ Read more ][210]
[ Coatings ][211]

### Introducing Olive Drab Green

## A bold new PVD coating for extreme conditions

Responding to market demand for durability and style under the toughest conditions, Ionbond proudly
unveils its latest [decorative color][212]: Olive Drab Green (ODG) PVD coating for metal substrates.

[ Read more ][213]
[ Events ][214]

### Ionbond's 2025 highlights

As the year closes, we take a clear look at what we achieved together. We value every step our
teams, customers and partners made possible. Each month in 2025 reflects a specific gift that shaped
our progress. Please unwrap the video and explore the gifts that defined 2025.

[ Read more ][215]
[ Service Centers ][216]

### Expanding coating capacity at Ionbond Berthecourt

We are pleased to announce a major investment at our Berthecourt facility: the installation of a new
Hauzer Flexicoat 1000 machine featuring advanced CARC+ technology. This strategic upgrade
significantly expands our coating capacity and productivity, enabling us to meet growing customer
demands with greater efficiency.

[ Read more ][217]
[ Collaboration ][218]

### Ionbond proudly receives Bosch Global Supplier Award

Ionbond has received a Bosch Global Supplier Award in the category "Materials and components" and
thus ranks globally among the best suppliers of Bosch. The theme of this year’s award ceremony was
“Challenge accepted: resilient partnerships, sustainable future,” in recognition of successful
collaboration.

[ Read more ][219]
[ Coatings ][220]

### Ionbond™ CVD 29 Ultra: Enhanced performance in continuous and interrupted cutting

Ionbond is pleased to announce our latest addition to our chemical vapor deposition ([CVD][221])
coating portfolio: Ionbond™ CVD 29 Ultra. This coating provides an impressive performance boost in
demanding applications, such as high-performance continuous and interrupted machining.

[ Read more ][222]
[ Collaboration ][223]

### 55 years of CVD coating: great memories and a promising future

Ionbond & Bernex celebrates 55 years of [CVD coating][224] excellence from Swiss origins to global
innovation. Discover our journey, future vision, and industry impact. Read the full interview to
explore how we’re shaping the next chapter in [surface technology][225].

[ Read more ][226]
[ Coatings ][227]

### Ionbond Ducro Coatings - cold dark black chrome PVD coating with superior characteristics

A striking cold anthracite color + excellent performance in extreme conditions. That’s the Ionbond
Ducro coating. Read more about the Ducro benefits and let yourself be wowed by its looks.

[ Read more ][228]
[ Service Centers ][229]

### Ionbond expands DLC coating capacity in Toulouse

Ionbond is proud to announce a strategic investment in its Grisolles facility near Toulouse, France,
with the installation of an HC1200 coating system from IHI Hauzer to significantly expand our DLC
(Diamond-Like Carbon) coating capacity.

[ Read more ][230]

# Creating a world of opportunities

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Growing from a small business in the Midwest to one of the largest privately held companies in the
world, Koch’s story is one of transformation: guided by principles, built for the long term and
focused on creating opportunities that help improve lives.  

[Get to know Koch][100]

What we do

## Everyday essentials. Transformative innovations.

Koch acquires, creates, develops and invests in a diverse group of companies, spanning from paper
goods to software and much more in between.

[See what our companies make][101]

## Put your potential to work

Find a role that matches your strengths at a company that helps you grow. With opportunities across
industries, Koch supports careers as unique as the people building them. 

[Discover opportunities][106]

## Principled thinking. Real results.

Principle Based Management™ and stewardship guide everything we do — from how we empower employees
to how we innovate, solve problems and contribute to society.

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced

last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.

solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.

## Our business model – unique integrated offering

Discover Oerlikon's business model and find out how we make products better. Each part of our
offering has unique strengths, and when combined, these strengths are a true game-changer in terms
of extending product life, saving costs and improving sustainability.
Coating services
From drill bits that stay sharp longer to turbine blades that withstand extreme heat, Oerlikon’s
coating services enhance the performance and durability of critical components across a wide range
of industries.
Coating equipment
From PVD & CVD coaters to thermal spray guns and entire systems, our coating equipment ensures
best-in-class results.
[Metal powder piling up]
Advanced materials
At Oerlikon, we engineer materials that drive innovation. Our portfolio includes ultra-fine metal
and ceramic powders for thermal spray and for 3D printing, as well as high-performance wires – each
designed to withstand pressure, heat, and wear.
Highly specialized components
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments.
Technology toolbox

## Leading know-how in high-tech sectors

Oerlikon has a highly developed technology toolbox that drives our business model. This toolbox
enables our customers to decrease costs, improve their products' performance, and gain a competitive
edge.
[Material science icon - magnifying glass on small particles]
Material Science
Through continuous innovation, we create advanced materials that enhance product performance,
reliability, and efficiency. Our technologies – often refined through powder metallurgy – help our
customers achieve higher durability, energy efficiency, and competitive advantage in their
industries.
[PVD icon - electrons bouncing off a target]
Physical Vapor Deposition
In the PVD process, a high-purity, solid coating material (metals) is either evaporated by heat (arc
evaporation) or by bombardment with ions (sputtering). At the same time, a reactive gas (e.g.,
nitrogen) is added. The gas forms a compound with the metal vapor, which is then deposited on the
tools or components as a thin, highly adherent coating.
[Thermal spray icon - spray from a spray gun]
Thermal Spray
Thermal spraying is a cost-effective method for applying coatings that enhance surface properties.
In the simplest terms, thermal spray involves heating a feedstock material, generally in powder or
wire form, to a molten or semi-molten state. The feedstock is propelled using a stream of gas or
compressed air to deposit it, creating a surface structure on a given substrate.
[Advanced manufacturing icon]
Advanced Manufacturing
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments. Leveraging our expertise in additive metal manufacturing, we produce
lightweight, complex parts that enhance fuel efficiency in aerospace systems.

## 150 years of inventors and pioneers – watch the video to learn more about the 150-year history of
## Oerlikon

## PVD coatings enhance performance in electrosurgery

Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico’s journey with the Oerlikon **PVD coating BALIMED ARGENTA**.

A trusted partnership between Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico and Oerlikon Balzers delivers Brazil’s
most widely used bipolar forceps – combining antimicrobial protection and surgical precision.

In neurosurgery, where precision and sterility are paramount, the performance of surgical
instruments can directly influence patient outcomes. Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico, one of Brazil’s
leading manufacturers of surgical tools, faced a persistent challenge: tissue adhesion during
coagulation (sealing of small blood vessels) with bipolar forceps. The search for a more effective
and biocompatible solution led to a collaboration with Oerlikon Balzers’ antimicrobial coating:
BALIMED® ARGENTA.

[ Read more ][98]
1/1

## Thermal spray solutions extend range of Mazda MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV

Innovation in the automotive industry has been a driving force for change towards sustainability and
efficiency. The MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV exemplifies Mazda‘s innovative approach to automotive design.

By repurposing the traditional rotary engine (Wankel) as a range extender in a plug-in hybrid
powertrain, Mazda leveraged compactness and lightness to extend the vehicle‘s range significantly.

[ Read the full story ][99]
1/1

## PVD coatings replace PFAS for a safer and better tomorrow

Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), also usually called **“forever chemicals”**, have
attracted significant regulatory attention worldwide due to their indelible nature, potential health
risks, and environmental impact. These synthetic chemicals, used in numerous industrial and consumer
products from non-stick cookware to medical devices, mechanical seals as well as applications where
functional surfaces with non-sticking and low friction properties required.

[ Read more ][100]

## PVD coatings enhance performance in electrosurgery

Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico’s journey with the Oerlikon **PVD coating BALIMED ARGENTA**.

A trusted partnership between Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico and Oerlikon Balzers delivers Brazil’s
most widely used bipolar forceps – combining antimicrobial protection and surgical precision.

In neurosurgery, where precision and sterility are paramount, the performance of surgical
instruments can directly influence patient outcomes. Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico, one of Brazil’s
leading manufacturers of surgical tools, faced a persistent challenge: tissue adhesion during
coagulation (sealing of small blood vessels) with bipolar forceps. The search for a more effective
and biocompatible solution led to a collaboration with Oerlikon Balzers’ antimicrobial coating:
BALIMED® ARGENTA.

1/1

## Thermal spray solutions extend range of Mazda MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV

Innovation in the automotive industry has been a driving force for change towards sustainability and
efficiency. The MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV exemplifies Mazda‘s innovative approach to automotive design.

By repurposing the traditional rotary engine (Wankel) as a range extender in a plug-in hybrid
powertrain, Mazda leveraged compactness and lightness to extend the vehicle‘s range significantly.

[ Read the full story ][99]
1/1

## PVD coatings replace PFAS for a safer and better tomorrow

Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), also usually called **“forever chemicals”**, have
attracted significant regulatory attention worldwide due to their indelible nature, potential health
risks, and environmental impact. These synthetic chemicals, used in numerous industrial and consumer
products from non-stick cookware to medical devices, mechanical seals as well as applications where
functional surfaces with non-sticking and low friction properties required.

## Surface Technology, Inc. is an Innovative 

# Metal Finishing Company & Coating Specialist

Surface Technology, Inc. is driven to innovate and manufacture. Our team takes pride in taking on
challenging applications with an inventive mindset to create solutions for our electroless nickel
plating partners and manufactures of components requiring higher performance.

Since 1972, we’ve done this through a unique combination of being both a manufacturer of diamond
coatings, plating chemical products and running an active plating job shop. We operate in a solar
powered, zero discharge, and environmental award-winning facility with an extensive R&D laboratory.

STI focuses on electroless nickel so we can continually take this technology to new levels. Our
products include the breakthrough One-Plate® single component electroless nickel, and
high-performance nickel composite coatings with Teflon®, diamond, boron nitride, and silicon
carbide.

Just as importantly as the products we have innovated over the years are the products we have yet to
develop to meet the needs of our customers, our industry and our world.

## Latest News

### Zincate Zero® - The Future of Plating on Aluminum

[Zincate Zero®][29] has been developed by STI as the first aluminum pretreatment solution to
overcome the problems caused by standard zincates. Zincate Zero® prepares aluminum for electroless
nickel and other types of plating without contaminating the plating bath - as seen in the following
video [Click Here][30]

In electroless nickel plating, Zincate Zero® produces excellent adhesion, more consistent quality,
bath life up to more than 10 MTO's, significantly reduced waste, and greater productivity and profit

Zincate Zero® is a drop-in solution. Platers can simply replace their old-fashioned zincate with
Zincate Zero®. Everything else in the process remains the same. This patent pending solution is free
of cyanide, heavy metals, and PFAS materials.

### Ni-Grip® Friction Shims

Surface Technology, Inc. is the leading supplier of friction shims. [Friction shims][31] are
available in large or small quantities from STI with fast delivery times. We manufacture custom
friction shims in any shape or size, any thickness, and in multiple levels of roughness depending on
the level of friction and grip required. You may also send us your own friction shims, and STI can
coat them for you.

[Ni-Grip® Friction Shims][32] made by STI are used in countless applications in the automotive,
aerospace, wind energy, turbine, machining equipment, robotics, medical, dental, paper and many
other industries. These flat ring shims increase the friction, grip, torque, energy transfer and
other critical properties of these applications. These friction shims are especially useful in
mechanical assemblies, as electric motor shims, as torque converter shims, transmission
applications, drive systems and axle shim assemblies where exact alignment is important. Learn more
here: [

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

[ Report 2025 ][48] [ Report archive ][49]

## Q1 2026 results announced

We've published our results for the first quarter of 2026. Learn more about how we performed and
take a look at the Q1 highlights. 

[ View report ][50]

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

## Sustainability

We’re always finding new and exciting ways to make our products more sustainable and longer lasting.
Because paint matters – to us, to you and the world around us.

[ Find out more ][59]

## Driving innovation

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for
our customers, communities and the planet. Read on to learn more about our approach to innovation
and recent developments in paints and coatings technology. 

[ Find out more ][60]

#### Collaborations

Discover how we play a progressive role in cross-industry coalitions and consortia to help create a
more sustainable future.
[ Learn more ][61]

#### Partnerships

Meet our partners and learn how we’re rocking the art world with the Rijksmuseum and accelerating
innovation with McLaren.
[ Learn more ][62]

#### Initiatives

Every layer tells a story. Dive into some of our programs and projects to find out how we make the
ordinary extraordinary.

Creative Coatings Acquisition and Introduction:

We are back!

For the past 3 months, the four of us ([Chris Stevenson][43], [Bobby Malaczewski][44], Joseph Creek,
and [Jesse Creek][45]) have been working together towards purchasing Creative Coatings, and that
goal has finally become a reality. As of September 1st, we have acquired the [Creative Coatings
Co.][46]

What this means is that the four of us, along with Ron Plonkey, Anthony Citraro, and Mike Marsee,
will make up the new Creative Coatings Company. Rich Plonkey will be staying on temporarily to help
ease the transition. All of our products will continue to ship from the Michigan facility, giving us
a strong, centrally located distribution center for our expanding product offerings. Creative
Coatings Company will now be official distributors for the following product lines:

-AkzoNobel Aerospace Coatings- full tier 1 distributor
-Hentzen Coatings- full distributor
-NCP Coatings- full distributor

In addition to the above, Creative Coatings will now begin to fully stock a wide variety of coatings
and products from the following companies:

-PPG Aerospace- fully stocking both Deft and PPG Legacy items
-Spectrum Coatings

As a result, Creative Coatings Company will be increasing our inventory and carrying a wider, more
diverse selection of products from all five companies. We strive to maintain the fast turnaround
times, competitive pricing, superior customer service, and industry experience you’ve received in
the past. With over 100 years combined experience between the seven of us, we want Creative Coatings
to become the “creative” solution to all your aerospace coating needs.

Feel free to call or email us with any questions you may have regarding this transition.

We look forward to hearing back from you, and we would love the opportunity to earn your business!

August 31, 2023

Creative Coatings Acquisition and Introduction:

We are back!

For the past 3 months, the four of us ([Chris Stevenson][43], [Bobby Malaczewski][44], Joseph Creek,
and [Jesse Creek][45]) have been working together towards purchasing Creative Coatings, and that
goal has finally become a reality. As of September 1st, we have acquired the [Creative Coatings
Co.][46]

What this means is that the four of us, along with Ron Plonkey, Anthony Citraro, and Mike Marsee,
will make up the new Creative Coatings Company. Rich Plonkey will be staying on temporarily to help
ease the transition. All of our products will continue to ship from the Michigan facility, giving us
a strong, centrally located distribution center for our expanding product offerings. Creative
Coatings Company will now be official distributors for the following product lines:

-AkzoNobel Aerospace Coatings- full tier 1 distributor
-Hentzen Coatings- full distributor
-NCP Coatings- full distributor

In addition to the above, Creative Coatings will now begin to fully stock a wide variety of coatings
and products from the following companies:

-PPG Aerospace- fully stocking both Deft and PPG Legacy items
-Spectrum Coatings

As a result, Creative Coatings Company will be increasing our inventory and carrying a wider, more
diverse selection of products from all five companies. We strive to maintain the fast turnaround
times, competitive pricing, superior customer service, and industry experience you’ve received in
the past. With over 100 years combined experience between the seven of us, we want Creative Coatings
to become the “creative” solution to all your aerospace coating needs.

Feel free to call or email us with any questions you may have regarding this transition.

We look forward to hearing back from you, and we would love the opportunity to earn your business!

# What's PVD Coating?

Physical Vapor Deposition PVD coating refers to a variety of environmental friendly vacuum
deposition processes for producing metal-based hard coatings by means of generation of partially
ionized metal vapor, its reaction with certain gases and by forming a thin film with a specified
composition on the on substrates including metals, ceramics, glass, and polymers.
PVD is characterized by a process in which the material transitions from a condensed phase to a
vapor phase most commonly used methods are sputtering and cathodic arc. In sputtering, the vapor is
formed by a metal target being bombarded with energetic gas ions. Cathodic arc method uses
repetitive vacuum arc discharges to strike the metal target and to evaporate the material. After the
vapor phase, the material then back to a thin film condensed phase be a coating.

## Our Services

### TiN Coating

Titanium Nitride (TiN) is FDA approved, extremely hard, inert, thin film coating made of Titanium
and Nitrogen in gold color. TiN coating is suitable for many tooling and forming applications by
adding hardness and lubricity . TiN coatings are smooth and combine high density with exceptional
adhesion giving outstanding performance. 

### TiCN Coating

Titanium Carbo-Nitride (TiCN) is medium gray in color, It is a hard dense, adherent wear resistant
coating. TiCN is recommended for cutting, punching, and wear applications where moderate
temperatures will be generated. TiCN Coating has up to 750 Degree F thermal improved wear resistance
to abrasive. 

### TiAlN Coating

Titanium Aluminum Nitride (TiAlN) is violet in color. It is a hard coating with thermal and
oxidation resistance. Ideal coating for high speed and high temperature cutting applications. For
turning, TiAlN provide superior edge strength and wear properties, TiAlN coated inserts can run up
to 100% faster than uncoated grades and up to 40% faster than PVD TiN coated grades. For milling
applications, TiAlN coated inserts can machine up to 50% higher speed than uncoated grades.

### AlTiN Coating

Aluminum Titanium Nitride (AlTiN)  has the highest temperature resistance of any of the coatings
available, It also provides a high degree of surface hardness and maintains that hardness at
elevated temperatures. It is the coating of choice when you are dry machining, machining titanium
alloys, inconel, stainless alloys and cast iron. The advantage of the AlTiN film is its ability to
produce the Al203 when high temperatures are encountered.

##### coating type, tool life can be increased 500%. High quality PVD coating allows faster spindle
##### speeds and higher feed rates on cutting tool, allows dry (or near dry) machining in certain
##### operations.

## Medical Instruments

##### PVD coatings are biocompatible, very hard and inert, and don’t react with bone, tissue or
##### bodily fluids. PVD coated medical instruments improves functionality. Use TiN,  or other
##### coatings, to reduce galling, improve edge retention or improve tissue release.

## Oil and Gas

##### PVD and DLC coatings add temperature,  abrasion and chemical resistance to the parts in oil
##### drilling and process pipeline, valves. Provide corrosion protection and extreme hardness to
##### the materials used in oil and gas industry.

## Automotiv Parts

##### PVD coating reduces the friction between moving parts in the motor, improving the overall
##### efficiency of the vehicle performance. Automotive parts with PVD coatings are used to improve
##### the surface hardness, consequently strengthening materials.

## Stamping and Forming Tools

##### PVD coating's high hardness and low coefficient of friction on the tool protects the surface

##### resistant layer over the surface of the jewelry

## Firearms

##### PVD and DLC coatings add a durable, attractive look and performance to firearm components.

# What's PVD Coating?

Physical Vapor Deposition PVD coating refers to a variety of environmental friendly vacuum
deposition processes for producing metal-based hard coatings by means of generation of partially
ionized metal vapor, its reaction with certain gases and by forming a thin film with a specified
composition on the on substrates including metals, ceramics, glass, and polymers.
PVD is characterized by a process in which the material transitions from a condensed phase to a
vapor phase most commonly used methods are sputtering and cathodic arc. In sputtering, the vapor is
formed by a metal target being bombarded with energetic gas ions. Cathodic arc method uses
repetitive vacuum arc discharges to strike the metal target and to evaporate the material. After the
vapor phase, the material then back to a thin film condensed phase be a coating.

# Hello, we’re Hempel

We help you protect your most valuable assets with our high-quality coatings

###### Hello MyHempel

## Make your coating purchasing smoother than ever

Turn your coating purchasing truly digital with MyHempel. Everything you need to select, order and
access key information about your coatings – all in one platform.
[Explore MyHempel][1]
[Visual of Hello MyHempel][Visual of Hello MyHempel]

Dive into Possibilities

## From products to personalised solutions

[

### Discover our products

Learn more about Hempel's diverse coating solutions. Filter products, access information sheets, and
elevate your projects with ease.

Find the right coating
][2] [

### Coating system selector

Discover the efficiency of matching your unique criteria with the optimal coating solution. Try our
selector and find the right coating system.

Try it now
][3] [

### Discover MyHempel

Your digital platform to explore coatings, place orders, and manage documents in one simple
experience.

Learn more
][4]

Industries

## Coating solutions for every area

[
[A large oil storage facility with numerous storage tanks is spread out across a large area,
surrounded by mountains and a nearby city under a partly cloudy sky.]
Industry

### Energy & Infrastructure

Industry-leading protective coatings to optimise performance of energy and infrastructure assets.

Go to Energy & Infrastructure
][5] [
[A large container ship, loaded with multicolored shipping containers sails through calm waters near
a port at sunset.]
Industry

### Marine

Advanced coating solutions for the Marine segment, ensuring vessel protection and performance.

Go to Marine
][6]

[A living room with cozy blue armchair, decorative pillows, a geometric side table, and a plant in
front of a deep blue wall, with wooden flooring adding warmth to the space.]
Industry

High-quality coatings that offer both strength and beauty for your building's unique style and
aesthetic.

Go to Decorative
][7] [

background]

A complete range of both DIY and PRO coatings, designed for all types of yachts.

Go to Yacht

### Hempel achieves EcoVadis gold-medal score, now ranking among the top 5% of all companies

## TURNKEY PVD PROJECTS

Welcome to contact Hongfeng VAC to get to know our Turnkey solutions including batch type and inline
PVD coating systems, as well as pretreatment & post-pretreatment machines.

Hongfeng VAC provides a comprehensive range of non-standard vacuum coating systems and total
solutions. Our core product line includes vacuum evaporation coaters for plastic metallization, DC
and mid-frequency magnetron sputtering systems, and multi-arc ion plating units for hard or
decorative coatings.

Beyond new equipment, we offer complete refurbishment and upgrade services for existing systems to
extend their lifespan and performance. We also supply a full spectrum of essential auxiliary
equipment, genuine spare parts, and high-quality consumables, ensuring seamless operation and
minimal downtime for your production.

From initial concept and custom manufacturing to ongoing support and optimization, Hongfeng VAC
serves as your reliable single-source partner for the entire vacuum coating system.

## PVD HARD COATINGS

Hongfeng VAC specializes in manufacturing advanced functional hard coating systems designed for
critical industrial applications. Our equipment provides high-performance PVD (Physical Vapor
Deposition) coatings for a wide range of products including hardware tools, molds, cutting tools,
drill bits, stamping dies, and precision components.

We engineer our systems to deposit superior, wear-resistant coating layers such as Titanium Nitride
(TiN), Titanium Aluminum Nitride (TiAlN), Chromium Nitride (CrN), and Titanium Carbonitride (TiCN),
etc. These coatings significantly enhance surface hardness, wear resistance, corrosion protection,
and service life of the treated tools and parts.

Our solutions are built to deliver precise, repeatable, and efficient coating processes, enabling
manufacturers to achieve consistent quality and improved productivity. Trust Hongfeng VAC for robust
coating technology that adds durability, performance, and value to your most demanding tools and
components.


## MF MAGNETRON SPUTTERING MACHINE

## MF Magnetron sputtering machine can be used for decorative and functional PVD applications, it
## allows you to obtain deep black, dark chrome, blue colors easily. Mid-frequency magnetron
## sputtering can be also used for functional application, e.g. multilayer compositions and DLC
## coatings. We provide planar and cylindrical magnetron sputtering coating systems.

## VACUUM METALLIZING

## Vacuum metallizing is the most simple technology in PVD. It can make metal finishing on
## substrates very rapid. Vacuum metallization can be used for differenet usages, such as Christmas
## balls, cosmetic packages, plastic bottle caps, lighting reflectors, coffin handles, etc. We
## provide verical or horizontal vacuum metallizing chambers with one or two doors. Fast cycle
## efficient vacuum plating machine and small capacity machine can be provided.

## CUSTOM COATING SOLUTIONS

PVD technology is the ideal replacement for electroplating. It produces no waste chemicals, no waste
gas. Hongfeng VAC provide PVD systems for vacuum metallizing, magnetron sputtering, decorative PVD,
hard coatings for tools, as well as inline PVD systems for glass substrates.

Hongfeng VAC engineers and technicians provide customers professional suggestions on designing,
developing, manufacturing and programming PVD coating systems according to individual requirements
regarding to the size, technology, cathodes and coating configurations.

We can send our engineers to the client's worksite to provide technical support, including face to
face training and installation.

## PROJECT IN MEXICO

Hongfeng VAC has served his clients from more than 20 countries all over the world. We provide
services to the companies from America, Europe, Russia, Latin American areas.

We provide constant technical assistances to our clients and have been seeking for long term
cooperation.

## ARC-1000 Cathodic Arc Evaporation Machine
* 10~14 sets of cathodic arc evaportors for deposition
* Vacuum chamber volume [mm]: ø1000 x H1100
* Ideal size for industrial production 
* Applications: Decorative and functional 
* Diffusion pump/turbo molecular pumps options available
* Max. load: 500kg
* Optional: DC or MF magnetron sputtering system
* Footprint [mm]: L3200 x W1800 x H2300

## Plasma Immersion Ion Implantation and Deposition System
* Features
  * Stainless Steel double wall chamber with water cooling
  * Temperature control up to 350ºC
  * High voltage workpiece holder with water tower cooling and rotation
  * Filtered cathodic vacuum arc sources with full metallic plasma output
  *  Kaufman ion sources for sample cleaning
  *  RF-CCP source for gaseous plasma generation
  *  High voltage pulse modulator for sample bias

[Image]

* 4 sets of cathodic arc evaportors for deposition
* Vacuum chamber volume [mm]: ø500 x H600
* Smart option for small scale production
* Coatings: Decorative or functional titanium nitride(TiN), CrN, TiCN, AlTiN, etc
* Applications: Metal tools or stainless steel items
* Diffusion pump/turbo molecular pumps options available
* Max. load: 200kg
* Optional: DC or MF magnetron sputtering system
* Footprint [mm]: L2300 x W1500 x H1950

* DC or mid frequency magnetron sputtering cathodes
* Vacuum chamber volume [mm]: ø1000 x H1100
* Diffusion pump/turbo molecular pumps options available
* Type of magnetron: Planar or rotate magnetrons
* Application: Different metal coatings, optional composited coatings and multilayer coatings
* Optional: Cathodic arc evaporation system(AIP system). thickness monitor, linear ion source
* Footprint [mm]: L3200 x W1800 x H2200

* 6 sets of cathodic arc evaportors for deposition

W dzisiejszych czasach każdy ma dostęp do internetu, a [casino online za pieniadze][47] daje

setek automatów, gier karcianych czy ruletki w wersji live. Dzięki szybkim płatnościom i atrakcyjnym
promocjom rozgrywka staje się wygodna i ekscytująca. To forma hazardu, która łączy nowoczesną
technologię z emocjami znanymi z tradycyjnych kasyn.

## TURNKEY PVD PROJECTS

Welcome to contact Hongfeng VAC to get to know our Turnkey solutions including batch type and inline
PVD coating systems, as well as pretreatment & post-pretreatment machines.

Hongfeng VAC provides a comprehensive range of non-standard vacuum coating systems and total
solutions. Our core product line includes vacuum evaporation coaters for plastic metallization, DC
and mid-frequency magnetron sputtering systems, and multi-arc ion plating units for hard or
decorative coatings.

Beyond new equipment, we offer complete refurbishment and upgrade services for existing systems to
extend their lifespan and performance. We also supply a full spectrum of essential auxiliary
equipment, genuine spare parts, and high-quality consumables, ensuring seamless operation and
minimal downtime for your production.

From initial concept and custom manufacturing to ongoing support and optimization, Hongfeng VAC
serves as your reliable single-source partner for the entire vacuum coating system.

## PVD HARD COATINGS

Hongfeng VAC specializes in manufacturing advanced functional hard coating systems designed for
critical industrial applications. Our equipment provides high-performance PVD (Physical Vapor
Deposition) coatings for a wide range of products including hardware tools, molds, cutting tools,
drill bits, stamping dies, and precision components.

We engineer our systems to deposit superior, wear-resistant coating layers such as Titanium Nitride
(TiN), Titanium Aluminum Nitride (TiAlN), Chromium Nitride (CrN), and Titanium Carbonitride (TiCN),
etc. These coatings significantly enhance surface hardness, wear resistance, corrosion protection,
and service life of the treated tools and parts.

Our solutions are built to deliver precise, repeatable, and efficient coating processes, enabling
manufacturers to achieve consistent quality and improved productivity. Trust Hongfeng VAC for robust
coating technology that adds durability, performance, and value to your most demanding tools and
components.


## MF MAGNETRON SPUTTERING MACHINE

## MF Magnetron sputtering machine can be used for decorative and functional PVD applications, it
## allows you to obtain deep black, dark chrome, blue colors easily. Mid-frequency magnetron
## sputtering can be also used for functional application, e.g. multilayer compositions and DLC
## coatings. We provide planar and cylindrical magnetron sputtering coating systems.

## VACUUM METALLIZING

## Vacuum metallizing is the most simple technology in PVD. It can make metal finishing on
## substrates very rapid. Vacuum metallization can be used for differenet usages, such as Christmas
## balls, cosmetic packages, plastic bottle caps, lighting reflectors, coffin handles, etc. We
## provide verical or horizontal vacuum metallizing chambers with one or two doors. Fast cycle
## efficient vacuum plating machine and small capacity machine can be provided.

## CUSTOM COATING SOLUTIONS

PVD technology is the ideal replacement for electroplating. It produces no waste chemicals, no waste
gas. Hongfeng VAC provide PVD systems for vacuum metallizing, magnetron sputtering, decorative PVD,
hard coatings for tools, as well as inline PVD systems for glass substrates.

Hongfeng VAC engineers and technicians provide customers professional suggestions on designing,
developing, manufacturing and programming PVD coating systems according to individual requirements
regarding to the size, technology, cathodes and coating configurations.

We can send our engineers to the client's worksite to provide technical support, including face to
face training and installation.

## PROJECT IN MEXICO

Hongfeng VAC has served his clients from more than 20 countries all over the world. We provide
services to the companies from America, Europe, Russia, Latin American areas.

We provide constant technical assistances to our clients and have been seeking for long term
cooperation.

# Leading the Way in Materials Science

We’re committed to changing the world through the premium design, application, and service of
advanced materials. Our global team of experts ensure customized solutions and provide the technical
support and knowledge you need to thrive.

[Explore Products][186]
[Talk to a Specialist][187]

## Sustainability

At Indium Corporation, responsibility and care are at the heart of everything we do. As a premier
materials refiner, smelter, manufacturer, and supplier, we are committed to supporting sustainable
manufacturing across the global electronics industry.

[Explore Sustainability][188]
[Talk to a Specialist][189]

## Driving E-Mobility with Rel-ion^{™} Products

Explore Indium Corporation’s cutting-edge high-reliability soldering and thermal interface material
solutions

[Explore Products][190]
[Talk to a Specialist][191]

## Liquid Metal Pioneer

As the liquid metal pioneer, Indium Corporation is the first high-volume supplier of liquid metals
as a thermal interface material in electronics.

[Explore Products][192]
[Talk to a Specialist][193]

## We believe that materials science changes the world.

employees

facilities around the world

###### 90+

years of innovation fueled by curiosity

###### 20+

essential markets served

## About Us

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

[Read More][41]

### HISTORY

### BUSINESS

### Strategy

OUR BRANDS

Products

## Automotive Refinish

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

[Read More][45]

## Resin

The company produces a range of resins, especially Alkyd resins, which are included in many types of
paints in the way and proportion that suits the needs and requirements of these paints

[Read More][46]

## About Us

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

[Read More][41]

### HISTORY

### BUSINESS

### Strategy

### CSR

OUR BRANDS

Products

## Automotive Refinish

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

[Read More][45]

## Resin

The company produces a range of resins, especially Alkyd resins, which are included in many types of
paints in the way and proportion that suits the needs and requirements of these paints

[Read More][46]

## Nature's Hidden Economy

What is nature worth? It's both priceless and worth many trillions. Here's how it props up our lives
and economies, and what we can do to help it.

[ Invest in Nature ][59]
see our work in Maryland and D.C.

## Stepping Up Progress in this Defining Decade

Alongside communities, we’re urgently clearing obstacles and finding solutions to the climate and
biodiversity crises.

[Who We Are][60]

We are dedicated staff, scientists and members advancing effective, lasting conservation in more
than 80 countries and territories.

[What We Do][61]

To make the highest possible impact on the climate and biodiversity crises between now and 2030,
we’re developing breakthrough ideas, amplifying local leaders and influencing policy.

[How To Help][62]

There are so many ways to make positive change for our planet. Volunteer with us. Learn how to
reduce your carbon footprint. Donate to conservation work.

[Where We Work][63]

Dense rainforests, remote coral reefs and the hearts of major cities. Our strategies are as diverse
as the habitats and geographies in which we work.

## Our Goals for 2030

We’re racing to hit these targets to help the world reverse climate change and biodiversity loss.
Together, we find the paths to make change possible.

[View Our Priorities][68]
* [CO2 icon]
  
  ### 3B
  
  Avoid or sequester 3 billion metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions annually—the same as taking
  650 million cars off the road every year.
* [People Icon]
  
  ### 100M
  
  Help 100 million people at severe risk of climate-related emergencies by safeguarding habitats
  that protect communities.
* [Land icon]
  
  ### 650M
  
  Conserve 650 million hectares—a land area twice the size of India—of biodiverse habitats such as
  forests, grasslands and desert.
* [Ocean icon]
  
  ### 4B
  
  Conserve 4 billion hectares of marine habitat—more than 10% of the world’s oceans—through
  protected areas, sustainable fishing and more.
* [River icon]
  
  ### 1M+30M
  
  Conserve 1 million kilometers of rivers—enough to stretch 25 times around the globe—plus 30
  million hectares of lakes and wetlands.
* [Partnership icon]
  
  ### 45M
  
  Support the leadership of 45 million people from Indigenous and local communities in stewarding
  their environment and securing rights.
[View Our Priorities][69]

60+ Years of experience

NIPSEA Group is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry.
Headquartered in Singapore, with more than 148 NIPSEA companies spread throughout 28 geographical
locations, the group is Asia Pacific’s No. 1 paint and coatings manufacturer in both production and
sales revenue. After more than 60 years of growth, NIPSEA Group has over 31,000 employees with 118
manufacturing facilities and operations, efficiently serving all aspects of the business, from
production to customer satisfaction. With a focus on maximizing value to our customers, we push
boundaries to deliver high quality solutions that work better for all our partners, tradesmen, and
homeowners. The NIPSEA Group’s arsenal of solutions for the industry covers Architectural,
Industrial, Automotive and Marine Coatings, as well as a range of products beyond the world of paint
and coatings. We have an unyielding drive to focus on customers, providing innovation that works
best for all our stakeholders.

## ABOUT NIPSEA GROUP

60+ Years of experience

NIPSEA Group is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry.
Headquartered in Singapore, with more than 148 NIPSEA companies spread throughout 28 geographical
locations, the group is Asia Pacific’s No. 1 paint and coatings manufacturer in both production and
sales revenue. After more than 60 years of growth, NIPSEA Group has over 31,000 employees with 118
manufacturing facilities and operations, efficiently serving all aspects of the business, from
production to customer satisfaction. With a focus on maximizing value to our customers, we push
boundaries to deliver high quality solutions that work better for all our partners, tradesmen, and
homeowners. The NIPSEA Group’s arsenal of solutions for the industry covers Architectural,
Industrial, Automotive and Marine Coatings, as well as a range of products beyond the world of paint
and coatings. We have an unyielding drive to focus on customers, providing innovation that works
best for all our stakeholders.

Nippon Paint – We are Inspired by You.

## UNLOCK THE POWER OF PVD COATING

What is PVD Coating?

Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) coating refers to a range of vacuum-based techniques used to apply a
thin, protective film onto a surface. Through physical processes like heating, arc evaporation, or
sputtering, the coating material is vaporized and then deposited onto the target object — enhancing
its durability, performance, and wear resistance.

[Read more][20]

Why Choose PVD Coating? 

A PVD-coated component offers significantly enhanced resistance to heat and wear, helping to protect
the underlying material from premature degradation. This added layer of durability not only extends
the component’s service life but also reinforces its structural integrity, ensuring more reliable
and consistent performance even in demanding environments.

[Read more][21]

EXPLORE OUR COATING RANGE

Boost the productivity and lifespan of your manufacturing tools with the right coating solution for
your needs.

Titanium Nitride (TiN)

A reliable all-purpose coating designed to protect your tools from everyday wear and extend their
lifespan.

PentaForm

The next-generation upgrade to TiCN, engineered for high-performance machining tools used in
demanding metal forming and stamping applications.

Chromium Nitride (CrN)

The ideal solution for rubber and plastic injection applications, designed to prevent polymer
sticking and improve process reliability.

Aluminium Chromium Nitride (AlCrN)

Built for performance in high-heat environments, this versatile coating is ideal for cutting tools,
taps, and inserts in demanding machining operations.

[More Coating][22]

APPLICATIONS

### Cutting Tools

PVD coating is a game-changer for carbide cutting tools — delivering dramatically improved heat
resistance and tool longevity over uncoated alternatives.

### Mould & Dies

When top-tier finishing is non-negotiable, PVD coating becomes a must. It enhances tool durability
while guaranteeing that every finished product meets precise quality standards.

### General Engineering

Whether it's car parts or electronic devices, our skilled team and state-of-the-art equipment are
ready to provide high-quality coating solutions tailored to your needs.

## UNLOCK THE POWER OF PVD COATING

What is PVD Coating?

Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) coating refers to a range of vacuum-based techniques used to apply a
thin, protective film onto a surface. Through physical processes like heating, arc evaporation, or
sputtering, the coating material is vaporized and then deposited onto the target object — enhancing
its durability, performance, and wear resistance.

[Read more][20]

Why Choose PVD Coating? 

A PVD-coated component offers significantly enhanced resistance to heat and wear, helping to protect
the underlying material from premature degradation. This added layer of durability not only extends
the component’s service life but also reinforces its structural integrity, ensuring more reliable
and consistent performance even in demanding environments.

[Read more][21]

EXPLORE OUR COATING RANGE

Boost the productivity and lifespan of your manufacturing tools with the right coating solution for
your needs.

Titanium Nitride (TiN)

A reliable all-purpose coating designed to protect your tools from everyday wear and extend their
lifespan.

PentaForm

The next-generation upgrade to TiCN, engineered for high-performance machining tools used in
demanding metal forming and stamping applications.

Chromium Nitride (CrN)

The ideal solution for rubber and plastic injection applications, designed to prevent polymer
sticking and improve process reliability.

Aluminium Chromium Nitride (AlCrN)

Built for performance in high-heat environments, this versatile coating is ideal for cutting tools,
taps, and inserts in demanding machining operations.

[More Coating][22]

APPLICATIONS

### Cutting Tools

PVD coating is a game-changer for carbide cutting tools — delivering dramatically improved heat
resistance and tool longevity over uncoated alternatives.

### Mould & Dies

When top-tier finishing is non-negotiable, PVD coating becomes a must. It enhances tool durability
while guaranteeing that every finished product meets precise quality standards.

### General Engineering

Whether it's car parts or electronic devices, our skilled team and state-of-the-art equipment are
ready to provide high-quality coating solutions tailored to your needs.

## Who we are

Titanium Coating Services, Inc. is PVD (Physical Vapour Deposition) service provider based out of

# International Roof Coatings Day

 

**International Roof Coatings Day is an annual observance that raises awareness of the important
role roof coatings play in both new roofing projects and roof restoration. **

 

Roof coatings can help extend the life of existing roofs and may provide benefits such as improved
energy efficiency, reduced waste, and support for more sustainable communities, while the day
celebrates the people, products, and innovations that help protect and restore roofs around the
world.

 

More information about the holiday will be coming soon.

[International Roof Coatings Day Logo][International Roof Coatings Day Logo]
[paint roller][paint roller]

### Roof Coatings are Essential

**Roof coatings are designed for protecting and extending the useful service life of roof assemblies
for new construction and existing roof coverings.**

Roof coatings are applied to low slope roofs on residential, commercial, and industrial buildings to
extend the life of a roof by preventing water, chemical, or physical damage which saves money for
the building owner. Roof coatings are also the most effective and least costly option to help
buildings save energy and enhance sustainability.

## RCMA Testimonials

[Gabriela Blanco headshot][Gabriela Blanco headshot]

Joining RCMA has provided several key benefits to our company:
* Gaining insight into and responding to various regulations that impact our business.
* Actively contributing to the development of industry standards and practices.
* Collaborating as part of the association to educate lawmakers, contractors, and end users on the
  true benefits and advantages of cool roof coatings.

### Gabriela Blanco | Lanco & Harris Corp.

[Jeff Blank Headshot][Jeff Blank Headshot]

The RCMA is the only true unifying voice for the roof coatings industry. As an industry that is
subject to government regulation, uniting behind common goals and objectives is the only way to
ensure that our businesses will survive and thrive. Over the years, I have seen how the RCMA
collective organizing has thwarted numerous attempts to place onerous and restrictive requirements
and regulations on our products and services. The RCMA truly embodies that old say, “that when we
fight together, we win!”

### Jeff Blank | SR Products

[Abby Feinstein Headshot][Abby Feinstein Headshot]

RCMA has been invaluable to me in my Product Management role at CertainTeed. I am responsible for a
vast product scope with Commercial Buildings & Infrastructure and RCMA allows me to maintain a
strong pulse on industry trends from products to technical advances and legislative influences. In
my experience, trade organizations like RCMA function very much as an adhesive element for the
industry and our stakeholders.

  true benefits and advantages of cool roof coatings.

[Jeff Blank Headshot][Jeff Blank Headshot]

The RCMA is the only true unifying voice for the roof coatings industry. As an industry that is
subject to government regulation, uniting behind common goals and objectives is the only way to
ensure that our businesses will survive and thrive. Over the years, I have seen how the RCMA
collective organizing has thwarted numerous attempts to place onerous and restrictive requirements
and regulations on our products and services. The RCMA truly embodies that old say, “that when we

One system. Total clinical freedom. 



Long-term satisfaction for patients around the world.



ROOTT® is not just an implant company — it is a complete, intelligently engineered ecosystem
designed to support clinicians in every indication, every workflow, and every level of complexity.



From immediate loading to complex cases, from simplicity to advanced solutions, ROOTT® empowers
clinicians with confidence, consistency, and control. 



We strongly believe that everyone deserves access to world-class implants that restore health and
confidence. 

Through high scale, lean operations and fundamental education, we make implants more accessible and
affordable.

[Learn more][67]

### One Complete System for Every Indication

A unified implant concept covering conventional, basal, pterygoid and compressive solutions.

### 98% Proven Clinical Success

Backed by long-term clinical data and real-world outcomes, ROOTT® delivers predictable, reproducible
results you can rely on.

### Trusted in 80+ Countries Worldwide

Used daily by thousands of clinicians across the globe — from private practices to advanced surgical
centers.



### Reliable Quality. Uninterrupted Supply.

Precision manufacturing, rigorous quality control, and a stable global supply chain ensure
consistency you can trust — case after case. 

### Smart Choice. High Performance. Highly Affordable.

Premium clinical performance without premium barriers — designed to support growth, not limit it.

At ROOTT®, innovation is not accidental.

Every design decision is made with one goal in mind: to simplify clinical work while expanding
treatment possibilities.

Our agile, R&D-driven approach allows ROOTT® to evolve continuously — responding quickly to
clinician feedback, clinical challenges, and real-world demands.

This state-of-the-art implant system sets a new standard with its unparalleled stability and
innovative leak-resistant conical connection. It's designed for versatility, featuring adaptive
platform switching and a passive fit connection that excels in scenarios demanding additional load
capacity.

***Choose ROOTT R for a future-proof, reliable implant solution.***

placement in **height and width deficient bones** , offering an immediate solution for multiple unit
restorations across the upper and lower jaws.

customized to individual requirements. We have been catering to a wide spectrum of industries since
2004; offering both standard as well as tailor-made coating solutions to augment the performance of
various cutting tools, dies, moulds as well as components used in engineering, pharmaceutical and
aerospace industries. Our dazzling bouquet of glittering decorative coatings blend with and thereby
complement the needs of various segments of decorative industries. State-of-art glittering colour
coatings thus add a jewel to Surface Modification Technologies crown.

## The last floss holder you'll ever *own*.

A single piece of 304 stainless steel, machined to hold your floss taut and keep doing it for
decades. Familiar in the hand from the first use — load the floss you already trust, and rinse it
clean in moments.

[Shop Now][35]

Built to last

## *For decades.*

## Still holding firm — long after the rest give out.

##### Plastic holders flex, loosen, and crack — then they're replaced and forgotten. Machined from a
##### single billet of solid steel, ours holds your floss taut by unique design and keeps its shape
##### through a lifetime of daily use.

[Learn More][36]

## Flossing was overdue for a rethink.

**Problems hiding in plain sight**

The reusable alternative

## A reusable answer to a disposable habit.

Billions of plastic floss picks are thrown away every year — each one used for a few seconds, then
left to outlast us in a landfill or a waterway. It's a quiet, daily kind of waste: twice a day, by
almost everyone, the plastic piles up.

So we built the answer as a true alternative, not a compromise. It's intentionally shaped and sized
like the disposable flosser you already know. Load your own floss, keep it for life, and stop
feeding the stream of single-use plastic.

The Stainless Steel

## Built to serve, not to be trashed.

We built this to serve you — not to be thrown away. So we designed out everything that could make it
fail: no welds to crack, no glued joints to loosen, no moving parts to wear, no plastic to fatigue.
What remains is the simplest possible form — a single billet of 304 stainless steel, CNC-machined to
high precision into one solid piece that won't loosen, corrode, or wear out.

The result is a quiet, lifetime servant. Its non-porous surface resists fingerprints and water
spots, rinses spotless, and is dishwasher-safe — so it looks considered on the counter rather than
used, for years to come.

Every use, a gain — not a loss

## About 20 cm of floss a session. Nothing more.

We treasure value — so we designed to consume as little as possible. Buy the holder once, and each
session takes only about 20 cm of floss, and every use becomes a small gain instead of a loss.

Why it's different

## Made well. Made once.
* ### Built to last a lifetime
  
  Precision-machined from solid 304 stainless steel. Nothing to wear out, nothing to replace.
* ### Holds floss taut 
  
  A unique and precise geometry keeps the floss taut and secure, so every pass stays precise and
  controlled.
* ### Your favorite floss
  
  Everyone flosses differently. Use the floss you already prefer — no cartridges, no lock-in.
* ### Effortless to clean
  
  A single, non-porous piece with no seams or joints to trap residue. A quick rinse leaves it
  spotless.

1 / of 4

Our philosophy

## Sustainability isn't a sacrifice. It's an *invitation* to invent something better.

We don't accept that the greener choice has to be the lesser one. Real progress isn't won by giving
things up or settling for less — it's created. It comes from the harder, more rewarding work of
designing a genuinely better alternative: an object so well made you'll never want to replace it.

Less waste, by way of more thought. That belief is the whole reason Synerponics exists.

— **The Synerponics Team**

### Is it easy to use?

Yes. There's no new flossing technique to learn — you floss exactly the way you already do. The only
thing to pick up is how to wrap the floss onto the holder, and that takes seconds. We've included
step-by-step schematics and a short video to walk you through it.

### Does the holder work with any floss?

Yes. Load whatever floss you already like — there are no cartridges or proprietary refills. You just
