## The last floss holder you'll ever *own*.

A single piece of 304 stainless steel, machined to hold your floss taut and keep doing it for
decades. Familiar in the hand from the first use — load the floss you already trust, and rinse it
clean in moments.

[Shop Now][35]

Built to last

## *For decades.*

## Still holding firm — long after the rest give out.

##### Plastic holders flex, loosen, and crack — then they're replaced and forgotten. Machined from a
##### single billet of solid steel, ours holds your floss taut by unique design and keeps its shape
##### through a lifetime of daily use.

[Learn More][36]

## Flossing was overdue for a rethink.

**Problems hiding in plain sight**

The reusable alternative

## A reusable answer to a disposable habit.

Billions of plastic floss picks are thrown away every year — each one used for a few seconds, then
left to outlast us in a landfill or a waterway. It's a quiet, daily kind of waste: twice a day, by
almost everyone, the plastic piles up.

So we built the answer as a true alternative, not a compromise. It's intentionally shaped and sized
like the disposable flosser you already know. Load your own floss, keep it for life, and stop
feeding the stream of single-use plastic.

The Stainless Steel

## Built to serve, not to be trashed.

We built this to serve you — not to be thrown away. So we designed out everything that could make it
fail: no welds to crack, no glued joints to loosen, no moving parts to wear, no plastic to fatigue.
What remains is the simplest possible form — a single billet of 304 stainless steel, CNC-machined to
high precision into one solid piece that won't loosen, corrode, or wear out.

The result is a quiet, lifetime servant. Its non-porous surface resists fingerprints and water
spots, rinses spotless, and is dishwasher-safe — so it looks considered on the counter rather than
used, for years to come.

Every use, a gain — not a loss

## About 20 cm of floss a session. Nothing more.

We treasure value — so we designed to consume as little as possible. Buy the holder once, and each
session takes only about 20 cm of floss, and every use becomes a small gain instead of a loss.

Why it's different

## Made well. Made once.
* ### Built to last a lifetime
  
  Precision-machined from solid 304 stainless steel. Nothing to wear out, nothing to replace.
* ### Holds floss taut 
  
  A unique and precise geometry keeps the floss taut and secure, so every pass stays precise and
  controlled.
* ### Your favorite floss
  
  Everyone flosses differently. Use the floss you already prefer — no cartridges, no lock-in.
* ### Effortless to clean
  
  A single, non-porous piece with no seams or joints to trap residue. A quick rinse leaves it
  spotless.

1 / of 4

Our philosophy

## Sustainability isn't a sacrifice. It's an *invitation* to invent something better.

We don't accept that the greener choice has to be the lesser one. Real progress isn't won by giving
things up or settling for less — it's created. It comes from the harder, more rewarding work of
designing a genuinely better alternative: an object so well made you'll never want to replace it.

Less waste, by way of more thought. That belief is the whole reason Synerponics exists.

— **The Synerponics Team**

## Customers are saying

4.55 ★ (11)
Verified

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is it easy to use?

Yes. There's no new flossing technique to learn — you floss exactly the way you already do. The only
thing to pick up is how to wrap the floss onto the holder, and that takes seconds. We've included
step-by-step schematics and a short video to walk you through it.

### Does the holder work with any floss?

Yes. Load whatever floss you already like — there are no cartridges or proprietary refills. You just
use your own floss, about 20 cm per session.

### Does it hold the floss taut?


Yes. It's a proven design, refined and validated by thousands of users, that keeps the floss firm
and taut through every pass, so it won't sag or slip the way flimsy holders do. And if you like even
more tension, just wrap the floss one extra loop around the post — a quick adjustment that tightens
it further. Taut floss is what actually cleans between your teeth.


### How often do I need to refill?

There are no refills to buy — you simply reload your own floss. Each use takes ~20 cm, so a standard
40 m spool lasts around 200 sessions. You only ever replace the floss, never the tool.

### Is it safe to put in my mouth?

Yes. It's food-grade 304 stainless steel — non-toxic, non-porous, and safe for everyday use in your
mouth. (The gold version's titanium-nitride coating is biocompatible too — the same finish used on
surgical instruments.)

### Is it hygienic?

Yes. It's a single, non-porous piece of steel with no seams for residue to hide in, and you use
fresh floss every time. Rinse after use; it's dishwasher-safe for a deeper clean.

### Will it chip or damage my teeth?

No. It's designed to be gentle: at just** 12 g — around half the weight of a spoon **— with smooth,
rounded contact points. Even an accidental knock against your teeth won't chip or harm them.

### How long will it last?

With proper care, it's built to last a lifetime. Because it's cut from a single piece of 304
stainless steel — with no moving parts to loosen or wear down — it keeps its shape and performs like
new for years. The only thing you'll ever need to replace is the floss.

### How much plastic do I save?

Used twice a day, one holder replaces roughly 7,300 disposable plastic flossers over 10 years — all
kept out of landfill.

# Leaders in technology

## About Us

Teer Coatings Limited is a leading provider of advanced surface engineering solutions, specialising
in the application of cutting-edge coatings to enhance the performance and durability of diverse
materials. Utilising state-of-the-art physical vapor deposition (PVD) Magnetron Sputtering, the
company excels in depositing thin films with tailored properties. These coatings exhibit exceptional
characteristics like high hardness, wear resistance, and corrosion protection, contributing
significantly to various industries, including aerospace, Motorsport, Sensors and industrial
sectors.

 

The company's expertise extends to custom solutions for specific applications, ensuring optimal
functionality and extended lifespan of vital equipment. Teer Coatings Ltd plays a pivotal role in
advancing technological capabilities, fostering innovation, and providing essential solutions to
meet the evolving demands of modern industries.

component's performance and increasing it's chance of failure. Wear is a leading failure mode for

## Achieve more with UPT advanced coatings

Whether the equipment you operate is a UH-60 Blackhawk, pistol, or control valve, wear, corrosion,
and friction cause poor performance, loss of efficiency, increased maintenance, decreased
productivity, and increased safety risk.

The solution is simple and it’s on the surface. Our high-performance, nanocomposite surface coatings
have been engineered to extend the life of your equipment and components through improved surface
properties like increased wear resistance, decreased friction, and greater corrosion resistance.

United Protective Technologies’ proprietary coatings are applied using Physical Vapor Deposition
(PVD), Plasma enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD) & Cathodic Arc Deposition (ARC-PVD). Our

proprietary DLC coatings, have been proven to increase durability and improve overall operational
functionality for our clients.

## Physical Vapor Deposition Equipment Manufacturer

Headquartered in Colorado, Vapor Technologies, Inc., (VaporTech^{®}) is one of the world’s leading
physical vapor deposition (PVD) equipment manufacturers.



#### Equipment
* VaporTech is one of the world’s leading physical vapor deposition (PVD) equipment manufacturers.
  Our equipment also produces diamond-like carbon (DLC) coatings. Both processes can be run in the
  same chamber.
* We work with clients of all sizes in multiple industries. Our V.MAX1500^{™}, VTi-Series ^{™}, and
  Cadence^{®} Systems enable manufacturers to choose the perfect system for their size, industry,
  and application.

## Why Choose TS VTI

TS VTI designs, builds, sells, and services [**vacuum coating machines, technology, and
equipment**][84] for multiple industrial applications. We offer PVD systems based on magnetron
sputtering, thermal evaporation, and cathodic arc deposition. We also offer coating services for
those companies who prefer to outsource their coating needs. Our coating services are primarily used
for LED reflectors, [EMI-blocking PCB enclosures][85], cutting & forming tools for machine shops,
and FDA-approved coatings for medical instruments.

TS VTI maintains a diligent focus on [ISO 9001][86] standards, and that is reflected daily in the 
quality products and services delivered to our clients. In addition to our ISO 9001 certification,
TS VTI also maintains active [ITAR][87] registration, allowing us to support the programs falling
underneath the guidelines of the International Traffic in Arms regulations.

TS VTI continues after 39+ years to be the reliability and value leader for PVD equipment & services
because we are different than other suppliers:

## Why Choose TS VTI

equipment**][84] for multiple industrial applications. We offer PVD systems based on magnetron
sputtering, thermal evaporation, and cathodic arc deposition. We also offer coating services for
those companies who prefer to outsource their coating needs. Our coating services are primarily used
for LED reflectors, [EMI-blocking PCB enclosures][85], cutting & forming tools for machine shops,
and FDA-approved coatings for medical instruments.

quality products and services delivered to our clients. In addition to our ISO 9001 certification,
